# Grid Zine Fest (temporary)

> The coolest, queerest zine fest in Salt Lake City, Utah. Grid Zine Fest is an annual, screen-free, zine festival run by volunteers.

## Pages

- [Grid Zine Fest](https://copy-of-grid-zine-fest-ffr5lj.teleporthq.site): The coolest, queerest zine fest in Salt Lake City, Utah
- [About Grid Zine Fest](https://copy-of-grid-zine-fest-ffr5lj.teleporthq.site/about): An annual, volunteer-run, screen- and algorithm-free, zine festival in Salt Lake City, Utah featuring over 100 creatives.
